turns.text: That's a wonderful way to spend an evening together. It sounds like you've got a great night ahead. Did you manage to get any cycling or climbing in earlier this week, or has it been mostly work?

turns.text: A river ride sounds lovely. Sometimes a quiet week is exactly what you need to recharge anyway. I hope the cooking goes well tonight!
